thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx responses and increased timeouts observed in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate. Error rate >= 7% for last 3 minutes. Paging oncall.

ryan (oncall): I'm on it. seeing similar from the dashboard. Confirming impact: many requests returning 502/504 gateway errors.

eva (sre): tagging in. first quick checks: upstream pool showing high connect_errors and some NGINX 502 logs: 
```
[2026-03-14T14:04:21Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 upstream_connect_error, connection timed out
```
Looks like a backend saturation or network flakiness between router and inference hosts.

ashley (infra): checking metal host and network telemetry for eu-west-1. No large host reboots in the last hour. BGP and infra control plane OK.

mike (api): traffic spike? any customer batch jobs? Rate graph shows normal qps, but spike in tail latency and retries. Could be a flapping model server or a hot shard.

ryan (oncall): I can run a quick probe to a few model pods. `kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/model-abc -- curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://localhost:8080/health`

ryan (oncall): Running that against 10 pods — 6/10 returned 200, 4/10 timed out. Repro on host level.

eva (sre): Good. Let's avoid wide rollback. Plan suggestion: (1) divert new traffic off eu-west-1 using router weight (canary to eu-west-2), (2) scale up model pool in eu-west-1 as emergency, (3) enable fallback model variant for timeouts.

ashley (infra): I can shift traffic at the global router. Proposing 80% -> eu-west-2, 20% remain for probe and logs. Doing staged weights: 10 -> 40 -> 80 over ~5 min. Any objections?

mike (api): No objections. FYI function-calling customers may be sensitive to region change; notify CS. Also enable sticky session preserve? Router will preserve session affinity for 2m.

sam (cs): Notifying CS channel and a couple of large customers (via email template) to expect degraded responses if they hit eu-west-1.

incident-bot: Deploy gate: shaded traffic change requested by ashley (infra). Approvals: ryan (oncall), eva (sre). Executing shift now.

ashley (infra): Step 1 -> setting weights to 40% eu-west-2, 60% eu-west-1 now.

ryan (oncall): Observability: error rate dropping from 7% -> 3.5% as traffic moves. Latency p95 slightly improves. Continuing.

ashley (infra): Step 2 -> set 80% eu-west-2, 20% eu-west-1.

mike (api): Canary requests to eu-west-2 look clean. No spike in errors.

eva (sre): While traffic is diverted, let's scale eu-west-1 model pool x2 to reduce pressure and rotate pods. `kubectl scale deployment model-deploy --replicas=20 -n inference` and restart pods gradually.

ryan (oncall): Scaling started. Also enabling the per-route circuit-breaker to lower max-connections for eu-west-1 to avoid amplifying failures: `route-config set circuit-breaker eu-west-1 max_conns=50`

ashley (infra): eu-west-1 hosts show node-level network retries on nic0, pushing packets. I've raised a ticket with cloud provider NOC for potential host NIC degradation. Ticket: CLD-7712.

sam (cs): Customer reports: two enterprise customers reported timeouts around 14:01. Sent interim note. Will follow up with RCA once we stabilise.

incident-bot: SYSTEM: traffic weight change completed. Current weights: eu-west-2=82%, eu-west-1=18%. Error rate in eu-west-1 now 1.1% (from 7%), overall service error rate 0.8%.

mike (api): Re-running internal synthetic tests across endpoints — all green now. Some residual 5xx only in older model-variant, switching those requests to fallback variant.

eva (sre): Confirmed: scaling+rotation cleared many failing pods. We'll keep 20% traffic to eu-west-1 for additional verification for 15 minutes.

ryan (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall: issue appears tied to intermittent host NIC errors causing pod-level connect failures. We diverted traffic and scaled; cloud provider ticket opened (CLD-7712). Monitoring for 30m then begin gradual return if stable.

ashley (infra): I'll coordinate with provider NOC. Also adding runbook note to make traffic-diversion the first step for similar symptoms.

sam (cs): CS will send a status update to affected customers with ETA for RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned follow-up: postmortem owner = eva (sre). SLA impact: partial error-rate spike for ~18 minutes; some customers experienced timeouts.

ryan (oncall): Marking this as handoff. I'm ending my shift, handing to eva. Please ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

eva (sre): Taking over. Will own postmortem and coordinate with infra for permanent remediation (replace affected hosts, refine circuit-breaker defaults).

mike (api): Follow-ups: add smarter auto-fallback to regional routing when p50 connect_errors breach threshold, and add per-host nic failure alerts.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (temporary). If errors rise above threshold, incident will reopen automatically.
